deviations.claim_in_article: “Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.”
deviations.issue: The claim generalizes from the Ledger’s Brent-futures observation to oil prices across the whole market; the Ledger does not establish the market-wide outcome.
deviations.explanation: The Ledger verifies a brief narrowing and recovery in Brent futures (HF-009), not a market-wide result. The broader claim is an unsupported new fact and expands the verified scope.
deviations.qualifier_text: “briefly” and “soon” in the immediately preceding sentences qualify the described Brent price movement, but do not limit the market-wide claim.
